drivingQuestion: Which blessing exempts which food, and when does one person's blessing exempt everyone at the table?
outcomeNote: A mishna: rulings stated, with a single dissent from Beit Shammai whose scope the gemara later probes (berakhot.42b.9).

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בֵּרַךְ עַל הַיַּיִן שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַמָּזוֹן — פָּטַר אֶת הַיַּיִן שֶׁלְּאַחַר הַמָּזוֹן. בֵּרַךְ עַל הַפַּרְפֶּרֶת שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַמָּזוֹן — פָּטַר אֶת הַפַּרְפֶּרֶת שֶׁלְּאַחַר הַמָּזוֹן. בֵּרַךְ עַל הַפַּת — פָּטַר אֶת הַפַּרְפֶּרֶת. עַל הַפַּרְפֶּרֶת — לֹא פָּטַר אֶת הַפַּת. בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: אַף לֹא מַעֲשֵׂה קְדֵרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» This mishna explains those cases and those circumstances in which blessings recited over particular foods exempt other foods at the meal from the requirement to recite a blessing over them. «One who recited a blessing over the wine that» one drank «before the meal,» with that blessing «he exempted the wine that» he drinks «after the meal.» Similarly, «one who recited a blessing over the appetizers that» one ate «before the meal,» with that blessing «he exempted the appetizers that» he eats «after the meal. One who recited a blessing over the bread exempted the appetizers,» as they are considered secondary to the bread. However, one who recited a blessing «over the appetizers did not exempt the bread. Beit Shammai say:» The blessing recited over the appetizers «did not exempt even a cooked dish» that he eats during the meal.

segments.he: הָיוּ יוֹשְׁבִין — כׇּל אֶחָד מְבָרֵךְ לְעַצְמוֹ. הֵסַבּוּ — אֶחָד מְבָרֵךְ לְכוּלָּן.
segments.en: An additional halakha is cited: If several people «were sitting» to eat not in the framework of a joint meal, «each recites a blessing for himself. If they were reclined» on divans to eat, which renders it a joint meal, «one recites a blessing on behalf of them all.»

segments.he: בָּא לָהֶם יַיִן בְּתוֹךְ הַמָּזוֹן — כׇּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מְבָרֵךְ לְעַצְמוֹ. אַחַר הַמָּזוֹן — אֶחָד מְבָרֵךְ לְכוּלָּם. וְהוּא אוֹמֵר עַל הַמּוּגְמָר, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין מְבִיאִין אֶת הַמּוּגְמָר אֶלָּא לְאַחַר סְעוּדָה.
segments.en: Additionally: If «wine came before them during the meal, each and every» diner «recites a blessing» over the wine «for himself.» If the wine came «after the meal, one recites a blessing on behalf of them all. And he,» who recited the blessing over the wine, also «says» the blessing «over the incense» [«mugmar»], «although they only bring the incense» to the diners «after the meal.»

moves.summary: wine before the meal exempts wine after it; likewise appetizers; bread exempts appetizers but not the reverse
moves.about: whether a blessing recited over one food at the meal exempts a cooked dish as well

moves.cueHe: בית שמאי אומרים: אף לא מעשה קדרה
moves.summary: Beit Shammai add that a cooked dish too is not exempted
